          "tensors_and_shapes": "s[N,3,256] differentiable; m[3,256] differentiable marginal; computed in one deterministic full-population pass each epoch.",
          "index_normalization_reduction": "Mean over three levels; marginal KL-to-uniform is summed over 256 codes. Included once with coefficient lambda_bal=1.0.",
          "empty_group_rule": "No parent-group conditioning; if N=0 objective is invalid/NULL. All 256 codes remain in each level marginal.",
          "gradient_and_circularity": "Gradients flow via m and s into z,e. No argmin assignment is used in this term; thus it is not constant. The uniform target is fixed and parameter-independent."

          "tensors_and_shapes": "T is the set of train-only observed directed transitions (anchor item a,target item t), counted once per observed event; s[N,3,256] differentiable; r is a detached target distribution over third codes. prefix2(t)=(q[t,1],q[t,2]); n_train counts only successors in T whose frozen first two codes equal prefix2(t), with third code k3.",
